Hannah is treated here as a transliteration of Arabic هَنَاء (Hanāʾ) 'joy, happiness', from the root ه ن أ (h-n-ʾ). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave عائشة (ʿĀʾisha) as the Arabic form, which is a completely different name, and its Hindi column gave औँचह, which is not a word. Note that the English name Hannah is a separate Hebrew name (חַנָּה, 'grace/favour') and must not be merged with the Arabic form. Recorded at medium confidence because the Latin spelling is shared by two distinct names.
